payload.title: sens-enterprise-validation --release stops a release on every blocked claim and ignores the release profile's non_blocking_claims, so edge-agent-release failed on agent-v2.0.0-rc.5 for four claims the manifest classifies non-blocking
evidence: tools/gates/sens-enterprise-validation.ts:1709 (const blockedReleaseClaims = blockedClaims at origin/main 141202cd4; since 42695736f, 2026-06-08, it replaced the profile filter that rc4 7ba7ca2cc applied)

tools/gates/sens-enterprise-claims.json:290 (release profile edge-agent-scada-display lists runtime-io-safe-state-closure, cloud-edge-command-lifecycle-closure, opcua-s7-physical-write-closure and sx1302-vendor-hal-hil-closure under non_blocking_claims, with a rationale)

.github/workflows/edge-agent-release.yml:125 (gates:sens-enterprise-validation --release exited 1 with 6 pass, 4 blocked on tag agent-v2.0.0-rc.5, run 40555277480; Build and Create GitHub Release were skipped)
package.json:168 (gates:sens-enterprise-validation:self-test was invoked by no workflow)
payload.rule_violated: A release profile's blocking_claims and non_blocking_claims are the contract of that release artifact; the gate must evaluate a profile release against exactly that classification, and every gate self-test must run in CI
payload.notes: Fix: releaseBlockingClaims() applies the profile classification; blocked claims outside blocking_claims are still printed as NON-BLOCKING in release output. The gate self-test now covers the three cases (profile non-blocking, no profile, profile blocking) and ci-affected runs it before the gate. Release path: suderra-agent 2.0.0-rc.6, because the release workflow builds the commit a tag points at and agent-v2.0.0-rc.5 stays on 58f0c3be6.
